Vikram K: FYI restorations from archive-bucket (snapshots from 2023) are failing with KMS decrypt errors after we renamed role backup-runner -> backup-runner-main during the tidy.
Aisha R: saw 5/120 restores hit AccessDenied around 11:07 UTC. Sample error from restore-worker:
```
2025-11-20T11:07:12Z restore-worker ERROR job=restore-1201 cause=AccessDenied kmsKey=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777666555:key/cmkey-77
CausedBy: NotAuthorizedException: User arn:aws:iam::777666555:role/backup-runner-main is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
```
Ben T: likely grants on cmkey-77 still list the old grantee arn:aws:iam::777666555:role/backup-runner which no longer exists. Grants are immutable, so rename broke them.
encops-bot: Detected 5 decrypt failures for cmkey-77 between 2025-11-20T11:06 and 2025-11-20T11:08. Recommended immediate mitigation: create scoped grants for affected snapshot_ids and retire them after use.
Vikram K: we should preserve EncryptionContextSubset when re-granting. Don't open general decrypt access.
Aisha R: running list-grants now for cmkey-77 and mapping to snapshot ids. Will paste minimal output.
Ben T: inventory (sanitized):
- GrantId g-77 grantee arn:aws:iam::777666555:role/backup-runner constraints {"snapshot_id":"snap-202311-04"}
- GrantId g-78 grantee arn:aws:iam::888444111:role/partner-copy constraints {}
infra-sre: cross-account grant present for partner-copy. That explains the two cross-account failures.
sec-oncall: mitigation plan approved: create per-snapshot grants for backup-runner-main and recreate or re-authorize partner-copy where needed. Use retire-on 8h and capture CloudTrail event IDs in the incident ticket.
Aisha R: create-grant command template used:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id cmkey-77 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::777666555:role/backup-runner-main --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"snapshot_id":"snap-202311-04"} --name tmp-restore-snap
```
Vikram K: replays after grants succeeded. Current: 5 -> 0 failing. Follow-ups: 1) add KMS-grant sweep to rename runbook, 2) preflight hook that blocks renames if kms_grants reference affected principals, 3) add detector for grants whose grantee principal doesn't exist (IAM lookup), 4) prefer key-policy cross-account statements over many per-role grants where practical.
encops-bot: suggested audit query: SELECT GrantId, GranteePrincipal FROM kms_grants WHERE GranteePrincipal NOT IN (SELECT arn FROM iam_entities) -- flag orphaned grants
Ben T: also note CloudTrail must retain CreateGrant/RetireGrant logs for at least 90 days for compliance. I'll add that to the ticket.
Vikram K: will file INC-2025-910 and attach grant ids + CloudTrail snippets and update the RBAC-rename checklist. Monitoring 24h. :white_check_mark:
